name: Sardine
description: The South African sardine (Sardinops sagax), the other great small pelagic of the upwelling system, famous for its vast shoals and boom-and-bust fortunes. Life-stage group of the source's juvenile and adult sardine compartments, pooled into one node because the two stanzas feed on the same plankton prey; sardine numbers swing with the climate and everything from gannets to fishermen feels it.
